description: Defines data structures, classes, and functions for collecting, managing, and formatting transmission metrics related to RLC (Radio Link Control) in a wireless communication system, including higher and lower layer metrics, mode-specific metrics, and formatting utilities.

classes.name: rlc_tx_metrics_higher
classes.description: Holds metrics related to SDUs, bytes, and discard counts at the higher layer.

classes.name: rlc_tm_tx_metrics_lower
classes.description: Metrics specific to Transmission Mode (TM) for lower layer.

classes.name: rlc_um_tx_metrics_lower
classes.description: Metrics specific to Unacknowledged Mode (UM) for lower layer.

classes.name: rlc_am_tx_metrics_poll_latency
classes.description: Metrics for polling latency in Acknowledged Mode (AM).

classes.name: rlc_am_tx_metrics_lower
classes.description: Metrics specific to Acknowledged Mode (AM) for lower layer.

classes.name: rlc_tx_metrics_lower
classes.description: Aggregates lower layer metrics, including mode-specific variants.

classes.name: rlc_tx_metrics
classes.description: Main structure combining higher and lower layer metrics.

classes.name: rlc_tx_metrics_interface
classes.description: Abstract interface for retrieving and resetting RLC transmission metrics.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a copy of the current higher layer metrics and increments the collection counter.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all metrics in the structure to initial state.

methods.name: format_rlc_am_tx_t_poll_latencty_metrics
methods.description: Formats polling latency metrics into a string buffer.

methods.name: format_rlc_tx_metrics
methods.description: Formats overall transmission metrics into a string buffer.
